message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 201, "amount_cents": 3873}, {"order_id": 203, "amount_cents": 18687}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 201, "amount_cents": 3873}, {"order_id": 203, "amount_cents": 18687}, {"order_id": 204, "amount_cents": 11000}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund for order 204 (amount_cents 11000) is requested in the signed Alpha batch but is not in the refunds table. The refunds table only contains orders 201 (3873) and 203 (18687). W2 reported only 201 and 203 as applied. Payouts withheld pending review of the missing 204 refund.

reply.thought: W2's applied list is missing order 204 ($110.00), which the signed batch requests. The rules say to check the refunds table for each requested refund before paying, so I'll pull that table first.

The refunds table has 201 and 203 but no entry for order 204 ($110.00), which the signed batch requests. The rules require a hold when a requested refund is missing, so I'll stop the batch for review before any payout is recorded.
